pictures.name: header
pictures.alt: Illustration seen from above: a Ringer court, a chalk circle on concrete inside a wooden border, with 13 marbles in an X in the middle and a shooter at the edge.
pictures.caption: Ringer: 13 marbles in a cross in a 10-foot ring. Illustration.

pictures.name: court
pictures.alt: Diagram of the Ringer court seen from above, drawn to scale: a 12-foot square of concrete with a raised wooden border, a 10-foot circle in the middle, a centre mark where the 13 marbles go, and two lag lines that touch the circle and run parallel to the border.
pictures.caption: The court: a 10-foot circle on a 12-foot square, with two lag lines touching the circle. The court is drawn to scale; the marbles are drawn larger. Diagram.

pictures.name: the-cross
pictures.alt: Diagram of the Ringer set-up drawn to scale: 13 marbles in an X, one in the middle and three along each arm, 3 inches apart centre to centre.
pictures.caption: The cross: one marble in the middle and three on each arm, 3 inches apart. The first shooter chooses which way the X points. Drawn to scale. Diagram.

pictures.name: lagging
pictures.alt: Diagram of lagging in Ringer: both players toss their shooters at the same time from the far edge of the circle toward the lag line; the shooter that stops closest to the line wins first shot.
pictures.caption: Lagging: both toss from the far edge at the same time; closest to the lag line shoots first. Diagram.

pictures.name: shooting
pictures.alt: Diagram of a Ringer turn seen from above: the first shot is taken from outside the circle and knocks a target marble out for one point; the shooter stops inside the circle, and the next shot is taken from where it stopped.
pictures.caption: Each marble knocked out scores one. If your shooter stays inside, shoot again from where it stopped. Diagram.

pictures.name: on-the-line
pictures.alt: Diagram of the on-the-line rule: a target marble lying on the circle's line with more than half of it outside counts as out, while a shooter lying on the line counts as in.
pictures.caption: On the line: a target on the line is out, a shooter on the line is in. Diagram.

pictures.name: share
pictures.alt: Ringer rules. Illustrated marbles set out in a cross, with a cat's eye shooter.
